# OEPV — Most Economically Advantageous Tender

<!-- Numbers generated by docs/economic-analysis/tco_oepv.py — do not edit manually -->
<!-- Regenerate with: python3 docs/economic-analysis/tco_oepv.py -->

The parametric OEPV simulator (ECO-01, ECO-02, ECO-05) is implemented in
`apps/agents/supply/cost-analyzer/src/scm_cost_analyzer/oepv.py` (Phase 9) and
vendored to `docs/economic-analysis/_oepv_vendor.py` for economic model reproducibility
without Nx workspace dependencies.

## OEPV Formula (Phase 9 — ECO-02)

```
Pe = pe_max * (1 - exp(-lambda * Ri / ribasso_ref))
total_score = weight_technical * Pt + weight_economic * Pe
offer_eur = base_d_asta_eur * (1 - ribasso_pct / 100)
is_anomaly_warning = ribasso_pct >= anomaly_threshold_pct
```

Parameters (all configurable in `params.toml`):

| Parameter | Value | Description |
|---|---:|---|
| `base_d_asta_eur` | 108,000 EUR | Mantis Base d'Asta |
| `weight_technical` | 0.70 | Technical score weight (70%) |
| `weight_economic` | 0.30 | Economic score weight (30%) |
| `pe_max` | 30.0 | Maximum economic score |
| `lambda_curve` | 3.0 | Discount curve steepness |
| `ribasso_ref_pct` | 20.0% | Reference discount for normalisation |
| `anomaly_threshold_pct` | 20.0% | Anomaly WARNING threshold (configurable) |

## PT Scenarios — SIMULATED TARGET

> **SIMULATED TARGET for economic evaluation** (ECO-04, SC-3).
> Technical scores PT are assumptions in the Assumption Register (see
> `docs/docs/assumptions/index.md`), not scores assigned by a jury.
> They do not constitute a performance guarantee.

Assumed discount: **12.5%** (typical range 10-15% with written justification).

| PT Scenario | Discount % | PT | Pe | Total Score | Offer (EUR) | Anomaly WARNING |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|:---:|
| Optimistic (PT=68.0) | 12.5 | 68.0 | 25.3994 | **55.2198** | 94,500.00 | NO |
| Base (PT=55.0) | 12.5 | 55.0 | 25.3994 | **46.1198** | 94,500.00 | NO |

**Optimistic scenario (PT=68.0/70):** technical score close to the theoretical maximum
(70 points on 100 with 70% weight). Assumption Register: A-051 — SIMULATED TARGET.

**Base scenario (PT=55.0):** realistic technical score for a solid, complete offer.
Assumption Register: A-052 — SIMULATED TARGET.

## Non-Linear Sensitivity — Discount 0-20% (ECO-05, SC-2)

Fixed PT = 68.0 (optimistic scenario). Non-linear curve with lambda=3.0.

| Discount % | Pe | Total Score |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 0.0 | 0.0 | 47.6 |
| 0.5 | 2.1677 | 48.2503 |
| 1.0 | 4.1788 | 48.8536 |
| 1.5 | 6.0445 | 49.4134 |
| 2.0 | 7.7755 | 49.9326 |
| 2.5 | 9.3813 | 50.4144 |
| 3.0 | 10.8712 | 50.8613 |
| 4.0 | 13.5357 | 51.6607 |
| 5.0 | 15.9373 | 52.3812 |
| 7.5 | 20.7086 | 53.8126 |
| 10.0 | 24.2628 | 54.9788 |
| 12.5 | 25.3994 | 55.2198 |
| 15.0 | 27.1273 | 55.738 |
| 17.5 | 27.9296 | 55.9788 |
| 20.0 | 28.5064 | 56.1519 |

> Full table (41 rows, step 0.5%): `docs/economic-analysis/sensitivity_table.csv`
> Source: `build_sensitivity_table()` from `_oepv_vendor.py` (Phase 9 — no re-derivation).

The curve is non-linear: most of the Pe gain is achieved in the first 10 percentage
points of discount. Beyond 15% the marginal gain is minimal.

## Anomaly Discount Threshold (art. 54 D.Lgs. 36/2023)

> **WARNING configurable at 20% — NOT a legal exclusion.**
>
> The `anomaly_threshold_pct = 20.0` threshold in `params.toml` is a **configurable
> conservative proxy** under art. 54 D.Lgs. 36/2023 (Italian Public Procurement Code).
> The Code provides an anomaly verification mechanism based on the average spread of
> submitted discounts — the exact legal formula requires specialist legal advice and
> depends on the number of competing offers.
>
> **This simulator does NOT implement the definitive legal formula**: it uses 20% as
> an indicative WARNING threshold. The `is_anomaly_warning` flag is CONFIGURABLE:
> modify `anomaly_threshold_pct` in `params.toml` and regenerate.

With a 12.5% discount, the anomaly WARNING is: **NO** (7.5 percentage points below the threshold).

## Reproducibility

The OEPV simulator is identical to the Phase 9 implementation (`oepv.py`).
A CI test verifies functional parity (`test_vendor_parity.py`, T-12-00-01)
to prevent drift between the vendor and the original source.

```bash
# Regenerate all outputs from params.toml
python3 docs/economic-analysis/tco_oepv.py

# Run vendor parity tests
python3 -m pytest docs/economic-analysis/tests/ -v
```
